mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as elevated rates increase discount rates and reduce corporate borrowing capacity, compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window or positive returns occur in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.0% signals economic weakness triggering monetary policy easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved liquidity and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in housing starts (HOUST) signal deepening economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue uncertainty.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE rise and HOUST decline fails to produce negative returns in >60% of cases or interaction term coefficient is positive with p<0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% sustained), S&P 500 underperforms by 1.5% over 60 days due to reduced liquidity and higher corporate borrowing costs compressing earnings multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of tightening cycles or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 550.0 (thousands) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through reduced construction activity and household spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0 or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) levels signal robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved economic momentum.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window or positive returns occur in <40% of high INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 5.0% with slow rise) trigger S&P 500 underperformance due to overvaluation and reduced policy flexibility, producing negative forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >40% of late-cycle expansions or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 98.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through reduced corporate investment and earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0 or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
